facts.fact: The BCEAO Instruction of 23 January 2024 distinguishes payment institutions from banks, microfinance institutions and e-money institutions as categories of payment service provider.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction of 23 January 2024 on payment services in the UMOA

facts.fact: The BCEAO list of payment institutions at 31 August 2026, published 8 October 2026, shows 11 licensed payment institutions in Senegal out of 34 in the UMOA, as reported by Benin Web TV.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction of 23 January 2024 on payment services in the UMOA
